subject: Literature
title: Hindu Creation and the Cosmic Cycle
description: A quick win: understand Hindu Creation and the Cosmic Cycle.

hook.text: In Hindu mythology, the universe is not created once but endlessly destroyed and reborn in cosmic cycles.

buildup.text: Brahma creates, Vishnu preserves, and Shiva destroys the universe so creation can begin again.

discovery.text: The Rigveda's creation hymn asks whether even the gods know how the universe began, embracing uncertainty.

twist.text: Hindu cosmology describes timescales of billions of years, strangely close to modern scientific estimates.

climax.text: The cyclical worldview influenced literature, philosophy, and the concept of karma across all of South Asia.

punchline.text: Ancient poets imagined cosmic timescales science confirmed.

quiz.question: What is unique about Hindu creation mythology?
options: The universe is created once and lasts forever
The universe is endlessly destroyed and reborn in cosmic cycles
Only one god controls all aspects of creation
